newsitem.title: UK: Billionaire Goldsmith launches EU referendum bid.
newsitem.headline: Billionaire Goldsmith launches EU referendum bid.

text.p: Billionaire Sir James Goldsmith said on Thursday his newly formed political party is to send a newspaper to every British home setting out its demands for a referendum on the country's relations with the European Union.
Some 24 million copies of the paper will be printed for the Referendum Party, which claims that British sovereignty is being seriously eroded by the growing power of Brussels.

The operation, which would stretch the finances even of the governing Conservatives or their main rivals, the Labour Party, is being paid for out of the 20 million pounds ($33.5 million) Goldsmith is spending to launch his new party.
He went to a printing plant in north-east London, one of several across the country which will print the paper, to launch the operation.

He immediately latched on to a report in the Independent newspaper suggesting that several EU states, including France and Germany, were planning eventually to bring in a harmonised tax system for countries which joined a single EU currency.
"We have been forecasting it for a long time -- it's now coming out in the open. The whole of the European project has been covered up by lies systematically," he said.

The new party plans to contest all the seats at the upcoming British election except those where the candidate of one of the main parties has come out for a referendum on the European Union. ($1=.5976 Pound)
